plaque: Brass planets the size of houses turn over the town. One of them is missing. Nobody admits to having it.
gap: An empty brass arm turns slowly over your head. It held a planet once. A label on it reads: RETURN TO THE GILT HOUSE. NO QUESTIONS ASKED. SOME QUESTIONS ASKED.
ledger: A visitors' ledger. Every name is crossed out except the last one. The last one is yours. It is written in someone else's hand.
